ASCII.fact: ASCII ( ASS-kee), an acronym for American Standard Code for Information Interchange, is a character encoding standard for representing a particular set of 95 (English-language–focused) printable and 33 control characters – a total of 128 code points.   ASCII hugely influenced the design of character sets used by modern computers; for example, the first 128 code points of Unicode are the same as ASCII.

Atmospheric entry.subject: Computer & IT
Atmospheric entry.question: One can estimate the time of travel for a gas molecule from the shock wave to the stagnation point by assuming a free stream velocity of _____/s and a nose radius of 1 meter, i.e., time of travel is a
Atmospheric entry.fact: One can estimate the time of travel for a gas molecule from the shock wave to the stagnation point by assuming a free stream velocity of 7.8 km/s and a nose radius of 1 meter, i.e., time of travel is about 18 microseconds. Atmospheric entry.question: For a real gas, the isentropic chain is unusable and a _____ diagram would be used instead for manual calculation
Atmospheric entry.fact: For a real gas, the isentropic chain is unusable and a Mollier diagram would be used instead for manual calculation. However, graphical solution with a Mollier diagram is now considered obsolete with modern heat shield designers using computer programs based upon a digital lookup table (another form of Mollier diagram) or a chemistry based thermodynamics program.

Atmospheric entry.subject: Computer & IT
Atmospheric entry.question: The chemical composition of a gas in equilibrium with fixed pressure and temperature can be determined through the _____ free energy method
Atmospheric entry.fact: The chemical composition of a gas in equilibrium with fixed pressure and temperature can be determined through the Gibbs free energy method. Gibbs free energy is simply the total enthalpy of the gas minus its total entropy times temperature.

Atmospheric entry.subject: Computer & IT
Atmospheric entry.question: The data base for a _____ free energy program comes from spectroscopic data used in defining partition functions
Atmospheric entry.fact: Gibbs free energy is simply the total enthalpy of the gas minus its total entropy times temperature. The program works by preserving the original elemental abundances specified for the gas and varying the different molecular combinations of the elements through numerical iteration until the lowest possible Gibbs free energy is calculated (a Newton–Raphson method is the usual numerical scheme).

Atmospheric entry.question: Other names for CEA are the "_____ and McBride Code" and the "Lewis Code"
